# Mashamba

> Mashamba FFP (U) Ltd is a Ugandan fresh produce airfreight exporter, supplying 9+ export-grade horticultural crops to international buyers with fast, careful handling from packhouse to aircraft and full export documentation. Focus: operational precision, logistics credibility, and modern Ugandan export excellence.

Mashamba is the trading name of FFP (U) Ltd, a registered exporter of horticultural products based in Uganda, exporting since 2001. The company sources, packs, and airfreights fresh produce (hot peppers, ginger, matoke, avocados, sweet potatoes, white African eggplant, cocoyam, sugar cane, apple bananas, pineapples, and seasonal Hass avocados) from Entebbe to international markets including the United Kingdom, the Gulf, and the EU. Buyers can review the product range, request a per-product export quote, and read free export guides.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ffpmashamba.com/): Uganda's trusted fresh produce exporter since 2001, airfreighting to the UK, EU, and Gulf with full export compliance.
- [About](https://ffpmashamba.com/about): The people behind Mashamba's Ugandan export story, 25 years in the trade, leadership team, and export credentials.
- [Products](https://ffpmashamba.com/products): Wholesale Ugandan horticultural produce, 9+ export-grade crops, quality graded and airfreighted from Entebbe.
- [Get an Export Quote](https://ffpmashamba.com/get-quotes): Send your requirements and get a tailored per-product export quote within one business day.
- [Contact Us](https://ffpmashamba.com/contact-us): Reach Mashamba's export team by form, phone, or WhatsApp.

## Products (crops)

- [Ugandan Hot Peppers](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-hot-peppers): Fresh scotch bonnet and habanero, 100,000 to 350,000 SHU, airfreighted fresh from Entebbe.
- [Ugandan Ginger](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-ginger): Fresh high-gingerol mature ginger root, available near year-round.
- [Ugandan Matoke](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-matoke): Fresh green East African Highland cooking banana, shipped green and handled with care at every step.
- [Ugandan Avocados](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-avocados): West Indian jumbo avocados, smooth green skin, 250 to 700g.
- [Ugandan Sweet Potatoes](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-sweet-potatoes): Dry, starchy white-fleshed Lumonde sweet potato, cured and soil-free for export.
- [Ugandan White African Eggplant](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-white-african-eggplant): Fresh white African eggplant (garden eggs) for the African-food trade.
- [Ugandan Cocoyam](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-cocoyam): Fresh cocoyam corms, malanga and eddoe, cured and soil-free for the diaspora kitchen.
- [Ugandan Sugar Cane](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-sugar-cane): Fresh-cut Ugandan sugar cane for chewing and juice.
- [Ugandan Apple Bananas](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-apple-bananas): Sweet Sukali Ndizi apple bananas, airfreighted fresh.
- [Ugandan Hass Avocados](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-hass-avocados): Hass avocados in season January to September, dry-matter tested at pick.
- [Ugandan Pineapples](https://ffpmashamba.com/products/ugandan-pineapples): Smooth Cayenne pineapples cut at eating ripeness, available all year round and flown crown-on; no phytosanitary certificate needed for UK or EU entry.

## Markets

- [Uganda Fresh Produce to the UK](https://ffpmashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-uk): Ugandan produce flown Entebbe to London Gatwick, duty-free under the DCTS and cleared through IPAFFS.
- [Uganda Fresh Produce to the UAE](https://ffpmashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-uae): Ginger, hot peppers, and matoke landed in Dubai at 0% GCC duty within days of harvest.
- [Uganda Fresh Produce to Saudi Arabia](https://ffpmashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-saudi-arabia): Ugandan fresh produce supplied to Saudi buyers by air.
- [Uganda Fresh Produce to the Netherlands](https://ffpmashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-netherlands): Ugandan hot peppers, ginger, and matoke for Dutch importers and wholesalers, duty-free under EBA.
- [Uganda Fresh Produce to Germany](https://ffpmashamba.com/markets/uganda-fresh-produce-germany): Matoke, Scotch bonnet, and ginger for German importers and Afro-food wholesalers, EU duty-free under EBA.

## Export guides

- [Export Resources Hub](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources): Practical guides to sourcing fresh produce from Uganda, the export process, documentation, and destination markets.
- [Why Source Produce From Uganda](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources/why-source-produce-from-uganda): Why UK, EU, and Gulf buyers choose Uganda, year-round equatorial supply and distinctive varieties.
- [How to Choose a Ugandan Produce Exporter](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources/how-to-choose-ugandan-produce-exporter): The certifications, handling records, and references to check before you order.
- [The Airfreight Export Process](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources/uganda-airfreight-export-process): Uganda's airfreight export process, step by step from farm to buyer.
- [Export Documentation Guide](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources/uganda-export-documentation-guide): The five-document pack that clears Ugandan produce into the UK and EU, including phytosanitary, IPAFFS, and TRACES.
- [Entebbe-London Air Route](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources/uganda-airlines-gatwick-route): The direct Entebbe to London Gatwick cargo route explained for produce buyers.
- [Seasonal Availability Calendar](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources/uganda-fresh-produce-seasonal-availability): When Ugandan produce is in season, a month-by-month availability guide and why Uganda supplies year-round.
- [Who Buys Ugandan Produce in the UK & Europe](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources/who-buys-ugandan-produce-uk-eu): The buyer groups behind UK and EU demand for Ugandan produce, from diaspora retail to wholesale markets.
- [Uganda vs Kenya: Sourcing Compared](https://ffpmashamba.com/resources/uganda-vs-kenya-fresh-produce-sourcing): Choosing your East African produce origin, how Uganda and Kenya compare for fresh produce buyers.
